messages:
erin (customer): hi, after upgrading to the latest python sdk our calls that used to include `encoding='utf-8'` are now throwing TypeError: unexpected keyword argument 'encoding'
alex (support): hey erin — sorry about that. which sdk version did you upgrade to? can you paste pip freeze and a minimal repro?
erin (customer): upgraded to 1.30.0 today via pip. pip freeze:
```
redwood-sdk==1.30.0
requests==2.31.0
python==3.10.12
```
minimal repro:
```
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=...)
resp = c.generate(model='xy-13', prompt='hello', encoding='utf-8')
```
error log: `TypeError: __init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'encoding'`
alex (support): ok thanks. i'm able to reproduce locally with 1.30.0. tagging eng. this looks like a signature change where the old `encoding` alias was removed.
maria (eng): ping — we shipped a cleanup in 1.30 that removed several deprecated aliases, including `encoding`. unfortunately the change slipped without a compatibility alias. the runtime treats `encoding` as unexpected and raises before request is sent.
erin (customer): is there a quick workaround? this is blocking our deploy. also saw some duplicate billing spikes earlier when our retry policy retried failed requests. any correlation?
alex (support): workaround: pin to 1.29.x for now or remove `encoding` from call and use the new param `text_encoding='utf-8'` (rename). to pin: `pip install redwood-sdk==1.29.4`
```
# temp pin
pip install "redwood-sdk==1.29.*"
```
alex (support): about the billing — if your client retried non-idempotent generate calls after getting e.g. a 401 or 5xx, you can see duplicate token usage. we recommend pinning + disabling aggressive automatic retries until we confirm a fix. james from billing is looping in.
james (billing): erin — we can review the charge window. if you share the request ids (from last 24h) we can flag duplicates and help with credits. reach out with the request ids or open a billing ticket #BILL-1127.
maria (eng): triage notes for eng: 1) regression introduced in 1.30.0 removing deprecated arg alias `encoding` (impact: customer-facing TypeError on call init) 2) non-idempotent retries observed by customer caused double token counts — client-side retry combined with failing first attempt is plausible 3) proposed short-term: publish 1.30.1 that reintroduces `encoding` as an alias (no-op) and adds a deprecation warning rather than hard removal 4) long-term: improve release checklist to run basic SDK compatibility smoke tests against trunk apps and examples
maria (eng): patch already drafted, will run CI. deploy-bot: staging release 1.30.1 candidate created: artifacts/artifact-1.30.1-candidate.tar.gz
alex (support): erin — expected timeline: we should have 1.30.1 candidate in staging within 2 hours and GA within the day if CI passes. recommended action for you: pin to 1.29.* until GA or remove/rename the param in your code.
erin (customer): thanks — pinning now and will send request ids for billing. please ping when 1.30.1 is out. :thumbsup:
maria (eng): will follow-up here when candidate promoted. adding a regression note to the release postmortem.
